# MU — Catalysts

## TL;DR

**AMD Q1 2026 earnings (May 5 AMC) — the binary gate from prior run — has now closed.** Results are in but not yet reflected in facts bundle; directional implication for MU HBM demand thesis pending market assessment. Next near-term event: JEDEC industry presentations May 12–13 (Micron presenting on cloud AI memory, 5–6 trading days). Q3 FY26 Micron earnings ~June 24, 2026 (consensus EPS $18.97, guide was $33.5B at ~81% GM). MU surpassed $700B market cap on May 5 after DA Davidson $1,000 initiation. [source: web_research/MU.json, run 20260505_211609]

## Upcoming events

- **JEDEC presentations — May 12 (mobile/edge) and May 13 (server/cloud AI memory):** Micron presenting at both; May 13 is the read-through for HBM4 technology and server memory demand signals. Potential HBM4 news catalyst. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **Q3 FY26 earnings — ~June 24, 2026** (earnings call ~July 1). Consensus EPS $18.97. Guide was $33.5B ± $0.75B revenue at ~81% non-GAAP GM. This is the next major scheduled binary. [source: web_research/MU.json earnings_info, run 20260505_211609]
- **Samsung HBM4 NVIDIA qualification:** Active risk event — Samsung targeting >30% HBM share. If Samsung qualifies HBM4 at scale for Vera Rubin, Micron's ASPs and market share face compression. [source: web_research/MU.json competitor_activity, run 20260505_211609]
- **SK Hynix $12.85B new packaging facility:** Announced April 22, 2026 — extending HBM market leader's manufacturing edge. [source: web_research/MU.json competitor_activity, run 20260505_211609]
- **U.S. CHIPS Act / MATCH Act:** Legislative activity targeting Chinese memory restrictions — Micron lobbying actively. Passage would extend pricing power. [source: web_research/MU.json geopolitical, run 20260505_211609]

## Recent news synthesis (last 14 days)

- **2026-05-05 — DA Davidson Buy $1,000 initiation (highest on Street):** MU surpassed $700B market cap; stock +~10% on the day. Melius Research initiated Buy at $700. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-05-05 — Micron ships 6600 ION SSD:** World's highest-capacity storage device — enterprise portfolio expansion. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-04-28 — TD Cowen raised PT $550→$660:** Maintained Buy, cited durable AI memory demand. [source: web_research/MU.json analyst_consensus, run 20260505_211609]
- **2026-04-02 — Erste Group downgraded to Hold:** Cited stretched valuation and memory cycle sustainability concerns. [source: web_research/MU.json ticker_news, run 20260505_211609]
- **Q2 FY26 print (Mar 2026):** Revenue $23.86B (+196% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $12.20, Q3 guide $33.5B at ~81% non-GAAP GM. [source: web_research/MU.json earnings_info, run 20260505_211609]

## Insider activity

No Form 4 data available in this run. No recent open-market purchases detected. [source: signals_combined.json swing_catalyst_news MU, run 20260505_211609]

## Analyst consensus

Rating: **Strong Buy** (~30 analysts). High end: DA Davidson $1,000 (highest on Street, initiated May 2026); Melius Research $700; TD Cowen $660; UBS $535; JPMorgan $550. Median ~$549 — stock at $640 has now exceeded most prior published targets, prompting ongoing upgrades. Bear outliers (BofA $300, Erste Hold) reflect cyclical mean-reversion concern. [source: web_research/MU.json analyst_consensus, run 20260505_211609]

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
